description: Public web page to PDF, from its address, printed as a browser would. Sends the URL to the conv2pdf API, writes the resulting PDF to the local output_path and deletes the conversion job afterwards.

output_path.description: Local path the converted PDF is written to. Always required for this tool. An existing file at this path is refused, never overwritten.

url.description: Address of the public web page to convert. The URL is sent to the conv2pdf API, which renders the page.

name: convert_url_to_pdf
